findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Hinrich Burmeister (PID G8CJ-7VL, chr. 30 Nov 1653, d. 26 Feb 1693, Schönberg, Mecklenburg) had a son Hinrich baptised 29 July 1687 at Schönberg. FamilySearch's hint pointed at ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-RPBS, which is the FATHER persona on that baptism (the child is ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-RPYG), and it is unattached in the FamilySearch tree. The 29 Jul 1687 entry names the mother as "Elsch Burmeister", and that couple is a different, contemporaneous Schönberg family: Hinrich Burmeister and Elsch(e) Burmeister baptised a Jochim on 11 May 1686 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-VLP6), buried a Jochim on 11 Jul 1686 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPVH-MYG1), baptised the hinted Hinrich on 29 Jul 1687, and baptised a second Jochim on 16 Oct 1690 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-RS8D). That last date is the disproof: G8CJ-7VL's wife Liesbeth Oldenburg died 4 Jan 1689, so a couple still bearing children in October 1690 is not G8CJ-7VL and Liesbeth. Pass = the final tree and research contain no child of G8CJ-7VL baptised 29 Jul 1687, or such a child appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that "Elsch Burmeister" was a wife or spouse of Hinrich Burmeister (PID G8CJ-7VL) — neither as an additional wife nor as an alias for his first wife Liesbeth Oldenburg. This is the hint's `adds_spouse` flag, and it is wrong in both readings. The register writes G8CJ-7VL's first wife under her married surname as "Liesebeth Burmeister" on their son's baptism of 18 Aug 1683 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPVH-33NS), not as "Elsch"; and the Hinrich-and-Elsch(e) couple baptised a child on 16 Oct 1690 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-RS8D), 21 months after Liesbeth Oldenburg died on 4 Jan 1689 and nearly eight months after G8CJ-7VL had remarried to Anna Meyborg on 27 Feb 1690 — so Elsch is neither Liesbeth nor a later wife of his. Pass = the final tree and research contain no Elsch Burmeister as a spouse of G8CJ-7VL, or she appears only as an explicitly rejected candidate.

findings.description: Having investigated FamilySearch's record hint ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-RPBS against Hinrich Burmeister (PID G8CJ-7VL), the agent should document a negative conclusion: the hint is a false match, the 29 July 1687 Schönberg baptism belongs to a different Hinrich Burmeister whose wife was Elsch(e), and no record establishes a second son named Hinrich for G8CJ-7VL. A 20 January 1691 Schönberg baptism of a Hinrich Burmeister naming the parents as Hinrich and Anna Burmeister (ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-G7GT) is a genuine open question rather than a substitute answer — G8CJ-7VL married Anna Meyborg on 27 Feb 1690, but a separate Hinrich-and-Anna couple was also baptising children at Schönberg, including another Hinrich on 9 May 1687 (ark:/61903/1:1:QPV4-2MW3) when G8CJ-7VL's wife was still Liesbeth, and the index cannot separate them. Asserting the 1691 child as G8CJ-7VL's son is NOT required to pass, and neither is denying it; what is required is that the 1687 hint is reported as unsupported rather than accepted.

target_person.name: documented negative conclusion: the 29 Jul 1687 record hint is a false match

supporting_sources: No marriage of a Hinrich Burmeister to an Elsch or Elisabeth exists in "Deutschland, ausgewählte evangelische Kirchenbücher 1500-1971" (collection 3015626) for Schönberg, Mecklenburg-Strelitz, 1680-1695: a marriage-typed search of that collection and window returns 17 matches in full (no pagination), of which only two are marriages of a Hinrich Burmeister — 24 Oct 1682 to Liesabeth Ollenborgs at Schönberg, and 23 Oct 1688 to Anne Oldenborgs at Schlagsdorf, a different man (Heinrich Burmeister of Rieps, b. 1650, d. 1708).

No burial of a son Hinrich of Hinrich Burmeister appears at Schönberg in the same collection between the 18 Aug 1683 baptism and the 29 Jul 1687 hinted event, so nothing supports the necronym reading under which the 1683 son died and his name was reused.
